arxiv-2012-13635.creator: Samy Badreddine, Artur d’Avila Garcez, Luciano Serafini, Michael Spranger
arxiv-2012-13635.description: Abstract Attempts at combining logic and neural networks into neurosymbolic approaches have been on the increase in recent years. In a neurosymbolic system, symbolic knowledge assists deep learning, which typically uses a sub-symbolic distributed representation, to learn and reason at a higher level of abstraction.

arxiv-2406-02380.title: EUFCC-340K: A Faceted Hierarchical Dataset for Metadata Annotation in GLAM Collections
arxiv-2406-02380.creator: Francesc Net, Marc Folia, Pep Casals, Andrew D. Bagdanov, Lluis Gómez
arxiv-2406-02380.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Francesc Net, Marc Folia, Pep Casals, Andrew D. Bagdanov, Lluis Gómez. In this paper we address the challenges of automatic metadata annotation in the domain of Galleries, Libraries, Archives, and Museums (GLAMs) by introducing a novel dataset, EUFCC-340K, collected from the Europeana portal. Comprising over 340,000 images, the EUFCC-340K dataset is organized across multiple facets – Materials, Object Types, Disciplines, and Subjects – following a hierarchical structure based on the Art & Architecture Thesaurus (AAT).

arxiv-2409-09863.description: Abstract . For a base b ≥ 2 b\geq 2 , the b b -elated function, E 2 , b E_{2,b} , maps a positive integer written in base b b to the product of its leading digit and the sum of the squares of its digits.

arxiv-2411-04243.title: ION-C: Integration of Overlapping Networks via Constraints
arxiv-2411-04243.creator: Praveen Nair, Payal Bhandari, Mohammadsajad Abavisani, Sergey Plis, David Danks
arxiv-2411-04243.description: Abstract In many causal learning problems, variables of interest are often not all measured over the same observations, but are instead distributed across multiple datasets with overlapping variables. Tillman et al. (2008) presented the first algorithm for enumerating the minimal equivalence class of ground-truth DAGs consistent with all input graphs by exploiting local independence relations, called ION.

arxiv-2502-06165.title: Adversarial Transform Particle Filters
arxiv-2502-06165.creator: Chengxin Gong, Wei Lin, Cheng Zhang
arxiv-2502-06165.description: Abstract The particle filter (PF) and the ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF) are widely used for approximate inference in state-space models. From a Bayesian perspective, these algorithms represent the prior by an ensemble of particles and update it to the posterior with new observations over time.

arxiv-2506-16344.description: Abstract We investigate the impact of the hadronic phase on jet quenching in nuclear collider experiments, an open question in heavy-ion physics. pmc-11599300.creator: John P. Savaryn, Kevin Coe, Matthew A. Cerny, Kevin Colizza, Patricia Moliner, Lloyd King, Bin Ma, Jim Atherton, Adam Auclair, Mark T. Cancilla, Marsha Eno, Ulrik Jurva, Qin Yue, Sean Xiaochun Zhu, Elyse Freiberger, Guo Zhong, Ben Barlock, Jonny Nachtigall, Laurent Laboureur, Sandeepraj Pusalkar, Ru
pmc-11599300.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Embedded within the field of drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK), biotransformation is a discipline that studies the origins, disposition, and structural identity of metabolites to provide a comprehensive safety assessment, including the assessment of exposure coverage in toxicological species. Spanning discovery and development, metabolite identification (metID) scientists employ various strategies and tools to address stage-specific questions aimed at guiding the maturation of early chemical matter into drug candidates.

pmc-11663519.title: Morphology and variations of middle cerebral artery: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11663519.creator: Urvi Sharma, Suman Verma, Subathra Adithan, Ashish Khobragade
pmc-11663519.description: To review morphometry, morphology, branching patterns and anomalies of middle cerebral artery (MCA). The databases of PubMed, Google Scholar and Scopus were searched with different keywords. The review comprised of 45 studies. Meta-analysis was done for dimensions of MCA, shapes, patterns and MCA anomalies. Newcastle-Ottawa Scale was used for assessment of literature.

pmc-12366123.title: An automated in-field transport and imaging chamber system for high-throughput phenotyping of potted soybean
pmc-12366123.creator: Xiuni Li, Menggen Chen, Shuyuan He, Mei Xu, Yao Zhao, Weiguo Liu
pmc-12366123.description: BackgroundIn major soybean-growing regions worldwide, vertical (three-dimensional) planting systems are widely adopted. Achieving precise phenotyping of individual soybean plants is crucial for breeding shade-tolerant cultivars and optimizing high yields. However, canopy shading from taller crops severely restricts the acquisition of phenotypic information from the lower-growing soybeans, and conventional phenotyping platforms struggle to meet the demands of such complex planting structures.

uslaw-usc-t10-s12521.title: 10 U.S.C. § 12521 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t10-s12521.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s12521.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel Generally); Chapter 1214 (Ready Reserve Mobilization Income Insurance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) The term “insurance program” means the Ready Reserve Mobilization Income Insurance Program established under section 12522 of this title. (2) The term “covered service” means active duty performed by a member of a reserve component.
